problems: Only republic-of-china and kuomintang were touched; the other four dossiers were not (pass, fix or thin). All 12 unapplied fixes were applied (republic-of-china 9: Guominjun 1927-05, July 1916 gain, five Japanese occupation pairs, Qingdao 1922, East Hebei 1935, Rehe and Inner Mongolia 1945-08, Tibet, Xinjiang, Vietnam/Guangzhouwan/Baitag Bogd; kuomintang 3: Guangdong 1918-1920 decision, 1928 merge, Guominjun 1927-05). Nine thin items were also taken up where a page allowed (Outer Mongolia 1919 and 1921, Ili rising, end of the Central Plains War, 1946 Manchuria counterpart, Dachen 1955 with keyframe split, Tibet note in keyframe 0, Jinggang base, New Guangxi clique note); the rest are in gaps.

Disagreements with the reviewer are in history/polities/_notes/ea-08-c.md: the Guominjun's allegiance to Nanjing is 20 June 1927 (land May); the Occupation of Mongolia page says October 1919 and is inconsistent on 1921, so the Mongolian Revolution of 1921 page was used; the 1945-08 gains are de jure (Manchukuo page: transfer to Chinese administration 'the following year'); kuomintang resolved as the Guangzhou southern government keeping Guangdong (loss of 1918 and gain of 1920 removed, contest kept).
ea-08-x should not give the Old Guangxi clique Guangdong 1918-1920 as a rival state: kuomintang keeps the province under the clique-led government.

republic-of-china /ledger/19 (1928-12 merge, region Cliopatria Kuomintang 1928) and kuomintang /ledger merge (same month, region the Beiyang remainder) describe one event with different regions by design.

Remaining validator warnings on republic-of-china: manchukuo, mengjiang and east-hebei-autonomous-council have no dossier yet; Baitag Bogd is not in the gazetteer; the Dachen circle resolves to no cells.
The new Dachen loss and the Japanese occupation regions refer to Cliopatria Empire of Japan shapes by year; if empire-of-japan is changed, these mirrors should be re-read.
